In the beginning there were no numbers[[File:Die Faces.svg|thumb]]Then the cosmic eye opened

It [[W:subitized|subitized]] six numbers: one, two, three, four, five, six

Was there more than six? 

One and two came together, but they only made three

But then two and four came together and made six

Close but not enough, Then five and two came together, and so there was seven
